coverage: Nine departments, 112 actual provinces, 340 municipalities and three Indigenous territories (TIOC), with CPV-2024 INE codes. Territorio Indígena Multiétnico (080901) is a direct child of Beni; the census placeholder province code is not represented as a province. All 343 municipal-level populations match the final INE census, totalling 11,365,333; parent totals are atlas sums. Full-detail WGS84 geometry from Lab TecnoSocial, derived from SDSN Bolivia 2025 and INE 2024, CC BY 4.0. These are reference boundaries, not a legal determination of unsettled jurisdiction. Source holes at Salar de Uyuni, Lake Poopó and Lake Uru Uru retain unassigned municipal coverage; the salt flat is not assigned to an invented municipality. Exterior source overlaps are clipped to the existing neighbours; the removed area is recorded in coverage.json. Existing neighbours keep ownership of the shared international frontiers. No GDP or subdivision flags are inferred.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
